summary.name: Blawgy
summary.one_liner: Blawgy is a paid service that researches keywords, writes, and publishes SEO blog posts to a business's website or CMS, aimed at getting cited by Google and AI search tools like ChatGPT.
use_cases: Publish SEO blog posts automatically to a business website
Find keywords customers ask AI and Google
Keep blog posts ranking by rewriting weak sections
Get cited by ChatGPT and Google AI results
Manage blog content from an AI agent via MCP
summary.what_it_does: Blawgy reads a business's site, takes a short set of questions about the business, and runs keyword research to suggest topics with search volume and difficulty attached. It drafts and publishes articles for chosen search phrases, with posts previewable before publishing and an option to publish automatically. Connected Search Console data and a reader-behavior pixel feed a monitoring loop that rewrites underperforming sections and can revert changes that hurt traffic. It also offers an MCP server so AI agents can research keywords, manage the plan, and write or publish posts, with deletes and publishes requiring confirmation.
notable: Self-refreshing posts: monitors Search Console and reader data, rewrites weak sections, and reverts changes that hurt clicks
MCP server lets AI agents run keyword research and publishing in plain English
Publishes to seven CMS and site platforms plus webhooks and API access
Shows Search Console results from customer case studies
caveats: Paid service: from $69/mo on Pro after a 3-day free trial, Pro+ at $89/mo; annual pricing is discounted and a limited-time offer that ends October 31st
Duda posts land as drafts for review rather than publishing directly
Platform list is limited to named integrations; other sites need API or manual upload
